cards.title: Where we are (2026-09-21, session 37)
items: Kit 0.14.0 is released; nothing is in flight; this session's branch session-37-tree-view carries c87ef7f, session 36's close
Engine session 10 vetted G0 on 0.14.0: the M0 contract is ready-green in CI run 35620384803 and faithful to its document at r3
It filed no-check-reads-the-source-document: G0 reads the contract alone, so five document-defined terms went undeclared and the door stayed green
It sent tree-view's request half: nine candidate criteria to strike and three OPENs
The one deliverable: tree-view at r2, signed by the PO seat; no check before r2

cards.title: The nine candidates
items: SC1: one command prints the work as a tree, spec doc down to checks, each node with a status, no stored copy
SC2: a pane follows the cursor: its path open, siblings folded with counts, about fifteen lines, redrawn on change
SC3: six statuses: to do, doing, done, failed, blocked, waiting on a seat; a failed check differs from one never run
SC4: each node's summary comes from its source, never written for the tree
SC5: typed links from sources: depends_on, served criteria, a finding's gate
SC6: an agent query prints one node in about twenty lines
SC7: a done node names its evidence: the command that proved it and the commit it ran on
SC8: at an approval the view says so and can run a configured notify command (the herdr seam)
SC9: tasks and approvals in flight have a home ADR 0027 allows

cards.title: The three OPENs
items: Where tasks, approvals and the cursor live under ADR 0027: derived from a per-unit template, an uncommitted harness file, or a committed file the view checks
How the view reads the spec doc's rows while ADR 0029 keeps tooling off document headings
Whether the per-unit task template (test list approved, tests written, red proved, green, commit approved, committed) becomes the kit's code-writing plan

derived-language, feature-document, spec-doc-type

cards.title: Glossary
items: Strike pass: each candidate criterion kept, struck or reworded by the seats before any check is written
r2: the request's second revision row, the struck criteria signed by the PO seat
OPEN: a question the request cannot close alone; a seat rules it under Decisions
Cursor: the one node in flight; the pane keeps its path open
ADR 0024: the unit graph, rendered by taskcontract graph
ADR 0027: no committed plan; the unit graph derives from the contract
ADR 0029: the feature document format; no tooling reads a document's headings
herdr: the terminal multiplexer the pilot runs sessions in; version 0.9.1 takes plugins
Later cut: a criterion moved out of the first build because it needs a request not yet built
